items.title: 16.1 Talaba ke liye aam hidayaat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the chapter opening and topic 16.1, printed page 337.

blocks.text: Chemistry laboratory ek chemist ki workshop hai. Yeh woh jagah hai jahan student ko muqarrar tareeqon (procedures) par chal kar maddon (substances) ki physical aur chemical khoobiyan dekhna (observe karna) sikhaya jata hai. Lab ka kaam shuru karne se pehle student ko lab ka naqsha (layout) aur lab ki mez aur side shelves par lagi fittings achhi tarah pehchan leni chahiye.

items: Students lab mein har waqt zimmedari (responsibility) se kaam karein.
Lab mein akele kaam na karein. Tajurbe (experiments) lab instructor aur doosre lab staff ki maujoodgi mein kiye jayein.
Lab mein kaam karte waqt hamesha lab coat aur safety goggles pehnein. Larkiyan kaam shuru karne se pehle apna scarf aur baal bandh lein.
Kaam shuru karne se pehle kisi bhi equipment ya tajurbe ke mumkina khatre (potential hazards) maloom karein. Zaroori hifazati ehtiyaat (safety precautions) har haal mein karein.
Lab mein bheer na ho; har student apni jagah par rahe aur doosron se mehfooz faasle par kaam kare.
Lab mein khane ki koi cheez na layein. Kisi compound ya gas ko kabhi chakhein ya soonghein nahi.
Koi hadsa (accident) ho ya sheeshe ka saman (glassware) toot jaye to foran lab incharge ko batayein.
Agar aap koi instrument ya equipment theek se istemal nahi kar sakte to instructor se madad lein.
Chemicals nali (drain) mein na bahayein aur chemical waste (fuzla) phenkne ke liye sewer istemal na karein.
Lab mein lage warning signs par amal karein.

blocks.prompt: Ek student instructor ke chale jane ke baad akele naya apparatus azmana chahta hai. Kaun si hidayaat yahan lagu hoti hain?
blocks.explanation: Do hidayaat: (ii) lab mein akele kaam na karein, tajurbe instructor aur lab staff ki maujoodgi mein hon; aur (viii) jo instrument theek se istemal karna na aata ho us ke liye instructor se madad lein.

items: Zimmedari se kaam; akele kaam nahi; lab coat, goggles, baal aur scarf bandhe hue.
Pehle khatre pehchanein; bheer nahi; khana nahi, chakhna ya soonghna nahi.
Hadsa ya tootna foran report karein; madad lein; nali ya sewer mein chemicals nahi; warning signs par amal.
